records.title: Design & Analysis of JPDAF Tracker with AI-Enabled Maneuvering Models
records.funder: Prince Sultan Defense Studies and Research Center (PSDSARC)
records.description: This project aims to advance radar target tracking through AI integration with the Joint Probabilistic Data Association Filter (JPDAF). It uses CNN and RNN/LSTM models to improve tracking in complex, high-acceleration scenarios and extends the work toward bistatic and passive radar systems.

records.title: Vehicle Access Automation
records.funder: Deanship of Postgraduate Studies and Scientific Research at Qassim University
records.description: A sustainable computer-vision gate-automation system with anti-spoofing. It detects the nearest vehicle using IoU, extracts vehicle make/model, Saudi license-plate recognition, and driver face recognition, then matches the features to an authorized database and applies a linear SVM for the final decision.

records.title: Design and Implementation of a Novel and Robust Automated Attendance System
records.funder: Partially Funded by the Innovation and Intellectual Property Center at Qassim University
records.description: A smart automated attendance system using computer vision and deep learning. It captures multiple images during class, recognizes faces to mark presence, detect latecomers, and support continuous attendance monitoring. The source describes YOLOv8 for person detection and InsightFace for face recognition, with 96.30% reported accuracy.

award.text: Selected among the top 20 of approximately 200 submissions in the Innovation Incubator organized by the Innovation and Intellectual Property Center at Qassim University; the source states 150,000 SAR was awarded to support launch as a start-up company.
award.alt: Automated attendance project team at the Innovation Incubator

records.title: Design and Implementation of a Robust Anti-Spoofing System for Vehicle Gate Access Using Recent Artificial Intelligence Techniques
records.funder: Logistically Supported by the Innovation and Intellectual Property Center at Qassim University
records.description: The system automates vehicle gate access using computer vision and machine learning. It detects the nearest vehicle using IoU, then extracts the vehicle make, license plate, and driver’s face. The features are matched to an authorized database and a tuned linear SVM makes the final access decision.

award.text: Selected among the top 20 of approximately 200 submissions in the Innovation Incubator organized by the Innovation and Intellectual Property Center at Qassim University; the source states 150,000 SAR was awarded to support launch as a start-up company.
